// why: Type-checks main.js, the part of the mod that uses Herdr. Herdr writes the type files it
needs (gpui-kit.d.ts, herdr.d.ts) into its own folder on every start, and they must not be
committed, so bin/typecheck-herdr copies them into .herdr-types/ first and skips this check
where Herdr isn't installed, such as on GitHub's CI.
strictNullChecks is off here, as in the jsconfig.json Herdr writes next to a mod: a view
sets its fields in init(), which TypeScript can't see as definite the way it sees a
constructor, so every field would read as possibly undefined. tsconfig.json checks the
plain modules with it on. skipLibCheck: Herdr's type files are not ours to fix.
